homeFaq.title: Questions travellers ask
homeFaq.subtitle: How LOC works, in plain answers.

items.q: How do I book a stay on LOC?
items.a: Send an inquiry from the stay's page. The host replies to you directly, and you arrange the stay together. LOC connects you; it never handles the booking or the payment.

items.q: Does LOC charge a booking fee?
items.a: No. LOC takes no commission on your stay and adds no platform fee to the host's price.

items.q: Where can I stay with LOC?
items.a: In Morocco, mostly in Marrakech: villas with private pools and gardens, and apartments in Guéliz. Each listing shows its location, photos and a starting price per night.

items.q: Can I book local experiences or travel guides?
items.a: Not yet. Local experiences, travel guides and stays in France and Belgium are coming soon, and each will appear on the site once it is ready.

items.q: I have a place in Morocco. How do I list it on LOC?
items.a: Tell us about it from the List with us page and our team will get back to you.

items.q: Which languages is LOC available in?

items.a: LOC is a travel connector from the Impactors Academy. It brings together places to stay and local knowledge chosen by people who know the places they cover, and puts travellers in touch with the local hosts behind them.
LOC began as LocEtudiant. In 2025 it was relaunched as LOC, with Lewis Rogers and Kodi Majok Matur as co-founders.
Co-founders Lewis Rogers and Kodi Majok Matur. LOC is part of the Impactors Academy, and its platform is built by IA Pro, the Academy's technical arm.

items.q: What does "the local way to see the world" mean?
items.a: It means the people recommending a place are the people who know it, and you reach the local host or provider directly.
Morocco today. France and Belgium are next.
